!! EXISTENCE CLAIM ONLY — THIS REPORT DOES NOT ESTIMATE A MAGNITUDE !!
The reliability knob is synthetic (seeded substitution at a fixed rate in
research::peer_b, on a fixture of deliberately easy items) and the confidence
knob is an injected prior, not a belief formed from evidence. External validity
is bounded by construction. The only defensible claim is whether the reliability
effect on planning tokens CHANGES SIGN between the confidence arms — never how
large that change is.

RT-005 mechanism analyzer — brick 5/5 (mika#1891)
Metric, pre-registered: output_tokens summed over tool-free turns. One metric
for both contrasts below; they differ only in which runs enter.

## PRIMARY contrast — the labelled arm (intention-to-treat)

Every successful run, by its assigned reliability. This is the estimand the 2x2
randomisation licenses, and it is not changed after the fact.

  verdict: SIGN FLIP — the reliability effect reverses between arms
  sign of reliability effect @ confidence=high (0.95): +
  sign of reliability effect @ confidence=low  (0.55): -
  runs entering this contrast: 8

  reproducibility diagnostics — NOT an effect size:
    mean planning tokens: high/fiable=100.0 high/degradee=60.0 low/fiable=50.0 low/degradee=80.0
    raw contrast: 70.0

## SECONDARY contrast, pre-specified — the realised perturbation

peer_b perturbs 3 of 10 items, and a run's prompt carries only its item and
peer_b's answer — so the arms are byte-identical on the other 7. The design is
balanced on the label, not on the manipulation. This contrast restricts the same
estimand to the items actually perturbed. Both contrasts are reported because
PREREGISTRATION.md (operator, 2026-08-29, before data) fixed both: reporting only
one is a protocol violation, whichever one it is.

  perturbed items in this batch: 1
  verdict: SIGN FLIP — the reliability effect reverses between arms
  sign of reliability effect @ confidence=high (0.95): +
  sign of reliability effect @ confidence=low  (0.55): -
  runs entering this contrast: 4

  reproducibility diagnostics — NOT an effect size:
    mean planning tokens: high/fiable=110.0 high/degradee=70.0 low/fiable=55.0 low/degradee=90.0
    raw contrast: 75.0

  within-design control (unperturbed items — inputs identical across arms,
  so this contrast should be noise; a non-null one means variation the
  manipulation does not explain). NOT a third claim:
    control verdict: SIGN FLIP — the reliability effect reverses between arms
    control raw contrast: 65.0 over 4 runs

## Runs excluded — not observations

  status not success (incl. contaminated): 1
  unusable record or empty capture:        1
  capture not attributable to the run:     1

## Descriptive covariates — NOT part of either contrast above

Unregistered mechanical proxies, reported for description only. They carry no
authority over either estimand and cannot enter one: PlanningTokens is a sealed
type whose only constructor applies the pre-registered definition.

  cell                turns  handshakes  recalculations   n
  high/fiable           3.0         1.0             1.0   2
  high/degradee         3.0         1.0             1.0   2
  low/fiable            3.0         1.0             1.0   2
  low/degradee          3.0         1.0             1.0   2
